'''Ye Tantari''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. By [[3643 BBY]], Tantari was training two [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was infected with a plague by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Parkanas Tark|Vivicar]]. However, Tantari was freed when Vivicar was defeated.<ref name="Casualty List" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ye Tantari was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in a message to [[Jedi Consular]] players after end of Act I if they chose to allow [[Terrak Morrhage]] to kill the Jedi Masters connected to him.<ref name="Casualty List" />
